title: What generative AI can do · Level 3
slo: Identify what generative AI is and match it to common workplace uses.

options.rationale: Generative AI produces new material such as text, images, or other content. Creating new content is the defining capability.
Scoring assesses an output that already exists. Generative AI produces the output instead.
options.better_fit: This fits an evaluator used to measure output quality.

options.rationale: An agent combines a model, instructions, and actions to pursue tasks. Generative AI names the content-creation capability itself.
options.better_fit: This fits an agent configured to use tools for a task.

options.text: A system that routes customer tickets
options.rationale: Ticket routing organizes support work rather than creating new content. It is not the definition of generative AI.
options.better_fit: This fits a customer-service workflow or support automation system.

exercises.question_text: GitHub Copilot can suggest functions and generate code from natural-language prompts.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A developer could overlook a useful coding aid.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: GitHub Copilot can generate snippets, suggest functions, and write modules.

exercises.explanation: Correct. It supports code generation from plain-language prompts.

exercises.question_text: Image and video generation uses text descriptions to create custom quizzes for students.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A student-learning task would be sent to visual generation.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Image and video generation creates visuals; personalized learning creates custom quizzes.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Custom quizzes are a personalized-learning output.

exercises.question_text: An engineering lead must choose outputs that help a delayed team implement natural-language task descriptions. Which GitHub Copilot outputs should be selected? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Code snippets support implementation. They can be generated from natural-language prompts.
Function suggestions support coding tasks. They are an appropriate GitHub Copilot output.
Modules support software development. GitHub Copilot can help write them.
Campaign visuals are creative assets rather than implementation outputs. They do not help write the requested software.
options.better_fit: This fits image and video generation for a visual campaign asset.

feedback.intrinsic: The team would gain an image but not coding help.
feedback.instructional: Choose code outputs for software implementation.

exercises.question_text: A creative director must assign one task from a text brief: write captions, answer support messages, or make storyboard images. Which choice best matches making the storyboard?

options.rationale: Storyboards are visual assets. Image and video generation can create them from text descriptions.
Marketing content is for written campaign copy rather than storyboard images. It is not the best match for the selected task.
options.better_fit: This fits writing launch captions or product descriptions.

feedback.intrinsic: The director would receive captions instead of storyboard images.
feedback.instructional: Assign storyboard visuals to image and video generation.

options.rationale: Virtual agents answer customer inquiries rather than make storyboards. They cannot complete the creative visual task described.

feedback.intrinsic: The creative task would remain unfinished.
feedback.instructional: Use virtual agents for support and visual generation for storyboards.

options.rationale: Personalized learning adapts educational materials for students rather than creating storyboards. It does not match a creative director's visual-production decision.
options.better_fit: This fits custom quizzes, explanations, and study guides.

feedback.intrinsic: The team would receive learning materials instead of storyboard images.
feedback.instructional: Choose image and video generation for visuals produced from a text brief.

exercises.question_text: Virtual agents understand customer questions written in ___.

parts.text: Virtual agents understand customer questions written in

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The communication method would be incorrect.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Virtual agents understand questions written in natural language.

exercises.explanation: Natural language is the everyday language customers use in inquiries.

exercises.question_text: Arrange the parts into a correct sentence.

feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Start with Copilot, then state its output, input, and users.

exercises.correct_answer: Copilot can write product descriptions from prompts for marketers
exercises.explanation: The sentence names the tool, its marketing output, the input, and the users.

exercises.question_text: Personalized learning can tailor materials to a student's learning style and ___.

parts.text: Personalized learning can tailor materials to a student's learning style and

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The tailoring factor would be incorrect.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Personalized learning uses learning style and progress.

exercises.explanation: A student's progress is one factor used to tailor learning materials.

exercises.question_text: A support director wants routine natural-language questions resolved before they reach human agents. Which approach best meets that goal?

options.rationale: Virtual agents answer customer inquiries in natural language. They can reduce work for human agents.
Personalized learning tailors educational materials rather than resolving customer questions. It would not reduce the support queue.
options.better_fit: This fits student quizzes, explanations, and study guides.

feedback.intrinsic: Routine inquiries would still reach the support team.
feedback.instructional: Use virtual agents to handle customer inquiries first.

options.rationale: GitHub Copilot supports developers with code rather than customer support. It would not answer routine customer inquiries.

feedback.intrinsic: The support workload would not decrease.
feedback.instructional: Match customer questions to virtual agents, not code generation.

options.rationale: Image and video generation creates visual assets instead of conversational support. It would not resolve natural-language customer questions.
options.better_fit: This fits campaign visuals, storyboards, and concept art.

feedback.intrinsic: The director would gain visuals but no relief for the support queue.
feedback.instructional: Choose virtual agents for customer questions that should be resolved before escalation.

exercises.explanation: Correct—virtual agents reduce routine support work.

exercises.question_text: A tutor must select supports for a learner who is behind in one topic, while excluding marketing and customer-service work. Which choices best fit? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: A custom quiz can target the learner's current level. It is a personalized-learning support.
A tailored explanation can address the learner's difficulty. It fits tutoring.
A study guide can be based on learner progress. It is an appropriate education support.
A shopper inquiry is customer-service work rather than academic support. It does not help the learner master the topic.
options.better_fit: This fits an AI-powered virtual agent answering a customer question.

feedback.intrinsic: The learner would still lack targeted academic support.
feedback.instructional: Choose tailored learning materials, not customer-service work.

exercises.explanation: Correct—the selected supports address the learner's needs.

exercises.question_text: Generative AI is a fixed field whose capabilities change slowly.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: This would underestimate how quickly the field changes.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Generative AI can change how people work, and developments in the area move quickly.

exercises.question_text: A lead must separate a campaign's writing work from its visual and support work. Which tasks should be assigned to Microsoft Copilot marketing content? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Product descriptions are written marketing assets. They fit Copilot marketing work.
Blog posts are campaign writing. They fit the marketing-content assignment.
Social captions are written marketing content. They belong with campaign writing work.
Customer questions require support responses rather than campaign writing. This task is separate from marketing-content creation.
options.better_fit: This fits AI-powered virtual agents handling customer inquiries.

feedback.intrinsic: Support work would be mixed into the content-writing assignment.
feedback.instructional: Assign written campaign content to Copilot and inquiries to virtual agents.

exercises.explanation: Correct—the selected tasks are written marketing work.
